## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit carries a `Signed-off-by:` line (`git commit -s`), and I agree to "Licensing of contributions" in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Unit tests pass locally, and `swiftformat --lint .`, `scripts/lint-strict-baseline.sh` and the string gates are green ([TESTING.md](../TESTING.md)).
- [ ] User-facing text is in the string catalogs, in German and English at least.
- [ ] No real health data, names, server addresses, tokens or secrets in code, fixtures or screenshots.
- [ ] A new data flow, permission or required-reason API is reflected in the privacy manifests and [docs/compliance.md](../docs/compliance.md).
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if the change is visible to people using the app.
